title: Booking.com prices
description: One row per property with its price for the stay, optional room-rate rows, and one status row per target.

type.title: Row type
type.description: hotel (a property with its price for the stay), room (one room and rate combination, only with includeRooms) or status (one per destination or property)

ufi.title: City id
ufi.description: Booking's city/area id (negative numbers are cities)

property_type.title: Property type
property_type.description: hotel, apartment, hostel, bed_and_breakfast, guest_house, holiday_home, villa, resort, homestay, motel, aparthotel, campsite, lodge, capsule_hotel, inn — or null for rarer types (see property_type_id)

stars.title: Stars
stars.description: Star rating as shown by Booking (null when the property has none)

transport.title: Public transport
transport.description: e.g. 'Terreiro do Paço station is within 500 meters'

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of price_total and price_nightly (your `currency` input)

price_total.title: Stay total
price_total.description: Booking displayPrice.amountPerStay on hotel rows, or the matching block finalPrice on room rows. Reported stay amount, not a verified final payable total; null means the source supplied no parsed price.

price_hotel_currency_total.title: Total in hotel currency
price_hotel_currency_total.description: The same stay total in the property's own currency

price_before_discount.title: Price before discount
price_before_discount.description: The crossed-out total when a deal applies (0 or null when none)

taxes_fees_excluded.title: Taxes and fees not included
taxes_fees_excluded.description: Reported excludeChargesAggregated.amountPerStay. Null means unavailable, not proof that all charges are included. Exhaustiveness, party adjustment and non-overlap are not verified; the aggregate's separate currency is not retained.

taxes_included.title: Taxes included
taxes_included.description: Legacy derived indicator: with a non-null price_total, true when the excluded aggregate is missing or zero; false when nonzero. It does not verify inclusion of all mandatory charges. Null when price_total is null.

charges_note.title: Charges note
charges_note.description: Booking chargesInfo.translation when supplied. Null is missing text, not proof that no additional charges or conditions apply.

free_cancellation.title: Free cancellation
free_cancellation.description: Hotel row: bool(policies.showFreeCancellation). Room row: whether freeCancellationUntil text exists. False includes missing information; neither value supplies a complete cancellation policy or penalty schedule.

no_prepayment.title: No prepayment
no_prepayment.description: Hotel-level showNoPrepayment badge converted to boolean. False includes an absent badge and does not prove advance payment is required; no amount or payment schedule is provided.

meal_plan.title: Meal plan
meal_plan.description: Hotel-level mealPlanIncluded.text on hotel rows; the matching block mealPlanIncluded.text on room rows. Hotel summary fields are not proven to describe one identical cheapest rate.

breakfast_included.title: Breakfast included
breakfast_included.description: Whether the hotel-level meal-plan text contains the English word breakfast. False can reflect absent or localized text; this is not a verified same-rate meal entitlement.

room_name.title: Reported room name
room_name.description: Hotel row: name of the block with the lowest numeric finalPrice.amount, selected separately from the headline display price. Room row: the matching block roomId's unit name. Not a verified headline-rate join.

rooms_listed.title: Room options
rooms_listed.description: Number of dictionary-valued blocks returned with the hotel result. Not complete property inventory and not necessarily the number delivered after a spending limit.

sold_out.title: Sold out
sold_out.description: True when Booking shows no price for these dates

alternative_check_in.title: Alternative check-in
alternative_check_in.description: Booking's suggested dates when the stay is unavailable

sponsored.title: Sponsored
sponsored.description: A paid placement in the results

host_type.title: Host type
host_type.description: PROFESSIONAL or PRIVATE, when Booking states it

query.title: Search target
query.description: The destination or hotel target this row came from

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Position in the destination results under sortBy (1 = first)

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.description: Guests the block is priced for

price_original.title: Original block price
price_original.description: The matching block originalPrice amount, with original_currency. This is not independently verified as the hotel-currency price.

original_currency.title: Original price currency
original_currency.description: Currency supplied with the block originalPrice; it need not be treated as proof of the property's native currency.

free_cancellation_until.title: Free cancellation until
free_cancellation_until.description: Source freeCancellationUntil text for the matching room block; nullable, not normalized to a timezone, and not a complete cancellation penalty contract.

only_x_left.title: Scarcity message
only_x_left.description: e.g. 'Only 2 left at this price on our site'

target.title: Target
target.description: The destination or hotel target as given

dest_type.title: Destination type
dest_type.description: CITY, REGION, DISTRICT, LANDMARK, AIRPORT, COUNTRY or HOTEL

status.title: Status
status.description: ok, no_results, not_found, duplicate or error

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: Properties already delivered by another target

total.title: Total available
total.description: Booking's result count for the destination

fetched_at.title: Fetched at
fetched_at.description: Actor UTC timestamp when the emitted row is constructed after parsing. Not a Booking price-acquisition timestamp or a guarantee about upstream cache age.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.description: One row per property with its price for the stay

rooms.title: Room rates
rooms.description: One row per room and rate combination (includeRooms)

status.title: Status
status.description: One row per destination or hotel target
